credits_rule: An export's credit is the credit of each enabled layer's instrument, in layer order, each line once, joined with one space. A layer whose instrument has no entry, or whose entry's credit is null, adds nothing. When no layer adds a line the export uses credit_fallback. credit stays the line for the AIA wall (sun-wall.html).
credit_fallback: Data courtesy of the teams of the instruments named in the instrument field.
credits_note: credit is the line exports write, ASCII only so it fits a FITS card; credit_source is the page it comes from. acknowledgement is the publication statement from source, verbatim (null when none was found), for a layer's acknowledgement field in a processing record. kind is required, suggested or none_found, as the source words it. All text was read on credits_read through a fetch tool that returns short fragments, so the long statements were rejoined from consecutive exact fragments; check one against its source before it is printed in a publication.
